note: Datetime Flatpickr provides field widgets datetime_flatpickr (field type datetime) and datetime_range_flatpickr / datetime_range_separate_inputs_flatpickr (field type daterange), plus a datetime_flatpickr form element. No global config (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush. Widget settings (schema datetime_flatpickr_config) are stored per component in core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.{type,settings}, keys include dateFormat, altInput/altFormat, enableTime, enableSeconds, time_24hr, minDate/maxDate, minTime/maxTime, minuteIncrement, position, weekNumbers, disabledWeekDays, disabledDates, inline, allowInput, mode. flatpickr 4.6.11 loads from CDN unless a local libraries/flatpickr copy exists. Medium/hard cases create datetime fields (field_dtf_*) on Article and set/read the flatpickr widget + settings on the default form display.

evals.prompt: What field widgets does the Drupal datetime_flatpickr module provide, and which field types do they apply to?
evals.expected_output: It provides datetime_flatpickr for datetime fields, and datetime_range_flatpickr plus datetime_range_separate_inputs_flatpickr for daterange (Date range) fields. It also exposes a datetime_flatpickr form/render element.

evals.prompt: There is no settings page for datetime_flatpickr. How do I make a Date/time field use the Flatpickr picker and configure its options (like enabling the time picker)?
evals.expected_output: There is no global config (configure=null). On the entity's Manage form display, set the Date/time field's widget to 'Flatpickr datetime picker' (datetime_flatpickr) and open the widget cog to set options such as enableTime, dateFormat, minDate/maxDate. Settings are stored per component in the entity_form_display config.

evals.prompt: Where does the datetime_flatpickr module load the flatpickr JavaScript library from by default, and how can I serve it locally instead of from the internet?
evals.expected_output: By default the flatpickr asset library loads flatpickr 4.6.11 from a CDN (cdnjs/cloudflare). If you place a local copy at libraries/flatpickr/dist/flatpickr.js, hook_library_info_alter (via _datetime_flatpickr_get_flatpickr_path) swaps the CDN URLs for the local files, so you can self-host.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a Date/time field using the Flatpickr widget. Inspect the live default form display and state the dateFormat configured on that field's Flatpickr widget.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_dtf_known component (widget datetime_flatpickr) has settings.dateFormat = 'd/m/Y'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has two Date/time fields, field_dtf_fp and field_dtf_plain. Exactly one uses the Flatpickr picker widget. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field uses the Flatpickr widget.
evals.expected_output: field_dtf_fp uses widget type datetime_flatpickr in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default, whereas field_dtf_plain uses the core datetime_default widget.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Date/time field field_dtf_task currently using the default 'Date and time' widget. Using datetime_flatpickr, switch this field's widget on the default form display to the Flatpickr datetime picker, and apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default set the field_dtf_task component type to 'datetime_flatpickr' and save (e.g. choose 'Flatpickr datetime picker' on Manage form display).
evals.difficulty_note: verify passes when field_dtf_task's widget type is datetime_flatpickr.

evals.prompt: My Article date field (field_dtf_time) already uses the Flatpickr calendar, but right now people can only pick a date. I want them to be able to pick a time as well. Turn that on for this field on the live site.
evals.expected_output: On the field_dtf_time component (widget datetime_flatpickr) in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default, set settings.enableTime to TRUE and save (the 'Enables time picker' option).
evals.difficulty_note: verify passes when field_dtf_time uses the datetime_flatpickr widget with settings.enableTime === TRUE.
